verdicts.reason: A: the headline dominates correctly and the subline reads well, but the CTA sits to the left of the headline so the reading order is backwards. The SAVE15% badge overlaps the top of the CTA pill, the logo is a speck under the button, the Quillbrook bag has shrunk to an unrecognisable dot, and the right image panel is empty. B: the oversized SAVE 15% badge is clipped at the left canvas edge and competes with a smaller headline, the subline wraps into an awkward short second line, and the CTA, tiny bag and tiny logo are jammed into one row. The large empty image block plus dead space on the right leave the banner lopsided and the product effectively lost.
